definitions.gloss: regular meeting; periodic meeting; standing meeting
definitions.explanation: A meeting held at fixed, recurring intervals such as weekly, monthly, or quarterly, as part of an organization's routine operations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{定期会議|ていきかいぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a regular meeting every Monday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定期会議|ていきかいぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This month's regular meeting was postponed to next week.

examples.japanese: {部署間|ぶしょかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定期会議|ていきかいぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧、⟦{情報共有|じょうほうきょうゆう}→情報共有：25347_jouhoukyouyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{連携|れんけい}→連携：05094_renkei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}している→強化する：25344_kyoukasuru⟧。
examples.english: Through regular inter-departmental meetings, we are strengthening information sharing and coordination.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧ (regular, periodic) + ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧ (meeting, conference). Standard workplace vocabulary for scheduled recurring meetings, in contrast to ⟦{臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}→臨時会議：27192_rinjikaigi⟧ (ad hoc/emergency meetings).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定期会議|ていきかいぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a regular meeting
- {定期会議|ていきかいぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧: to attend a regular meeting
- ⟦{月例|げつれい}→月例：14940_getsurei⟧{定期会議|ていきかいぎ}: monthly regular meeting
- {定期会議|ていきかいぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議題|ぎだい}→議題：11330_gidai⟧: agenda for the regular meeting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}→臨時会議：27192_rinjikaigi⟧: emergency/extraordinary meeting (unscheduled, called for urgent matters)
- ⟦{定例会|ていれいかい}→定例会：17068_teireikai⟧: regular meeting (shorter synonym, commonly used in local government and organizations)
- ⟦{朝礼|ちょうれい}→朝礼：16381_chourei⟧: morning assembly (brief daily gathering in Japanese companies)
